{{Top|leg}}
'''Anemonae''' was the name of a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]]<ref name="G10">{{GamerCite|10|Standoff on Leritor}}</ref> and [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> The [[Sauvax]] were known to eat them.<ref name="G10" /> A poisonous variety grew on Sedri, cultivated in [[Farm/Legends|farms]] within the [[sun caves]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]].<ref name="BGS" />
